stories.title: Submit and automatically adjudicate an eligible claim

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated owner has an active matching policy and provides all required synthetic document types
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner submits a valid first notice of loss
acceptance_criteria.then: the API creates one claim, executes the ordered workflow, records an automatic approval, creates one settlement, and returns HTTP 201

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated owner submits against an active matching policy but required document types are missing
acceptance_criteria.when: the workflow performs document and fraud checks
acceptance_criteria.then: the claim enters MANUAL_REVIEW with no settlement and the missing-document reason is auditable

acceptance_criteria.given: a request contains a future incident date or a non-positive claimed amount
acceptance_criteria.when: the claim endpoint validates the request
acceptance_criteria.then: the API returns HTTP 400 with field errors and persists no claim

acceptance_criteria.given: a request uses a policy that is inactive, outside its coverage period, or of a different claim type
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner submits the claim
acceptance_criteria.then: the API rejects the request before workflow execution with a specific 4xx response and persists no claim

stories.title: Enforce authentication, ownership, and administrative boundaries

acceptance_criteria.given: a request has no valid credentials
acceptance_criteria.when: it accesses a protected claim resource
acceptance_criteria.then: the service returns HTTP 401 without exposing claim data

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated customer account
acceptance_criteria.when: it calls an endpoint under /api/admin
acceptance_criteria.then: the service returns HTTP 403 and performs no administrative operation

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated customer requests another customer's claim
acceptance_criteria.when: the detail endpoint performs owner authorization
acceptance_criteria.then: the service returns HTTP 403 while the owning customer or an administrator remains authorized

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated administrator
acceptance_criteria.when: the administrator opens the claim queue and dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the service returns the cross-customer queue and aggregate status counts only through /api/admin

stories.title: Apply deterministic fixed-point assessment and fraud rules

acceptance_criteria.given: a claim amount, policy limit, deductible, and co-pay percentage
acceptance_criteria.when: the rules engine assesses payable value
acceptance_criteria.then: it caps at the insured sum, subtracts the deductible, applies co-pay, never returns a negative amount, and rounds money to two decimals with HALF_UP

acceptance_criteria.given: the assessed payable amount is zero
acceptance_criteria.when: the decision rule executes
acceptance_criteria.then: the claim is rejected and no settlement is created

acceptance_criteria.given: manual-review and rejection fraud thresholds are configured as 50 and 80
acceptance_criteria.when: scores 49, 50, 79, and 80 are evaluated
acceptance_criteria.then: the decisions are respectively AUTO_APPROVE, MANUAL_REVIEW, MANUAL_REVIEW, and REJECT

acceptance_criteria.given: a MOTOR, HEALTH, or LIFE claim
acceptance_criteria.when: required document rules are requested
acceptance_criteria.then: the engine returns the three claim-type-specific document identifiers defined by the business baseline

stories.title: Preserve settlement immutability and append-only audit history

acceptance_criteria.given: an automatically approved claim has no existing settlement
acceptance_criteria.when: the workflow settles the claim
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly one immutable settlement and a chronological settlement audit event are persisted

acceptance_criteria.given: the owner has a rejected claim and provides a valid reason
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner reopens the claim
acceptance_criteria.then: the status becomes REOPENED, the reopen count increases, the decision clears, and a new audit event is appended

acceptance_criteria.given: a settled claim is reopened and reprocessed without changing its payable amount
acceptance_criteria.when: the workflow reaches settlement again
acceptance_criteria.then: the existing immutable settlement is reused and no duplicate settlement row is created

acceptance_criteria.given: an empty test database
acceptance_criteria.when: the application context starts with Flyway enabled
acceptance_criteria.then: every versioned migration applies successfully and Hibernate validates the resulting schema

stories.title: Operate accessible customer and administrator portals

acceptance_criteria.given: the synthetic customer selects the customer workspace
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner claim list loads
acceptance_criteria.then: the portal shows the customer heading, owner-scoped list or empty state, and sends customer authorization

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer completes the synthetic first-notice form
acceptance_criteria.when: the claim API returns an adjudicated claim
acceptance_criteria.then: the portal presents the claim number, decision rationale, settlement reference, and audit timeline

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer has multiple claims
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer searches by claim number, policy, type, or status
acceptance_criteria.then: only matching claim cards remain visible

acceptance_criteria.given: the administrator opens claim details
acceptance_criteria.when: the selected claim is settled or reopened
acceptance_criteria.then: decision and reprocess actions appear only for domain-eligible states

acceptance_criteria.given: the portal runs at a 390 pixel viewport
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer opens and dismisses a modal using Escape
acceptance_criteria.then: the dialog closes, focus can return, and the page has no horizontal overflow

acceptance_criteria.given: a claim API request fails
acceptance_criteria.when: the portal receives the error response
acceptance_criteria.then: an inline accessible alert announces the failure without using a blocking browser alert
